rawFindings.title: Incorrect detection of arrow token in arrow-spacing rule
rawFindings.explanation: The original code used sourceCode.getTokenBefore(node.body) to find the '=>' arrow token, then traversed backwards to find the actual arrow token. The changed code instead iterates tokens forward from the first token of the node until the token with type 'Punctuator' and value '=>' is found, storing the previous token as 'before' and the next token as 'after'. This new logic can fail when the arrow function parameters or body tokens are followed by certain tokens causing incorrect identification
rawFindings.suggestion: Retain the original logic of starting from sourceCode.getTokenBefore(node.body) and moving backward to find the '=>' token or improve the new logic to robustly identify the tokens before and after '=>' ensuring correct handling in all syntax cases. Test with nested and complex arrow functions to validate.
